title: MASEMiner
tagline: Extract pairwise effect sizes and study metadata from primary studies for Meta-Analytic Structural Equation Modeling
description: MASEMiner — Direct information variant.  Extracts every reported pairwise effect size (correlations from matrices and prose, plus any other bivariate effect-size statistic) and coded study metadata, in the unified `effect_sizes._table` schema that downstream MASEM tools consume.  The matching Indirect-information variant (masem-tas20) extracts factor loadings and factor correlations instead.
task_description: Extract every reported pairwise effect size (with canonical and verbatim variable labels) and coded study/sample metadata for every sample reported in the paper.
context: MASEMiner workflow for primary studies that report effect sizes directly (correlation matrices, prose-reported correlations, or other bivariate effect-size statistics).
